task: Synthesize completed Jeju research into horse-level findings and distance-level observed racecourse characteristics.
scope: Six completed research topics: gate/lateral,moisture/month,foundation,body/load,recent form,training. Latest corroboration and conservative uncertainty override older preliminary summaries. Keep historical estimates as historical, not combine estimates across differently selected populations.
population_contracts: Gate:normalcomplete exact10 numbers1to10,3930races/39300starts. Body/load:normalcomplete7to13,positivebody/load,5206races/52155starts. Environmental exact-distance pairs and recent-form history-qualified evaluation subsets retain their own denominators.
claim_limits: Empirical associations in local Jeju records, not universal breed physiology, track-geometry mechanisms, pace/section/style aptitude, causal effects or validated correction table. No cross-breed comparison inferred.
adoption: No new fixed gate/environment/body/load/training correction and no operational-model update. Describe input priority as research interpretation, not learned importance weights. No independent future holdout.
